note: Local smoke runs on October 16, 2026 with a deliberately invalid dummy platform token. This is not live provider evidence; the owner protocol in live-setup.md produces live-evidence.json.
runtime: isolated Node.js loopback harness (Phase 11C platform credential)

observations.detail: The page rendered the platform section and both platform actions completed without any owner sign-in.

With only GITHUB_TEST_USERNAME and GITHUB_PLATFORM_TOKEN configured, the harness started, rendered the sign-in-disabled notice, rejected the sign-in action with signin_not_configured, and completed both platform actions.
HTTP 401 from the fixed fake credential; no owner reconnect classification and no real token sent.
No token, username, stable ID, or provider payload appears in the recorded events.

limitations: Local HTTP harness; production Better Auth callbacks, cookies, and scheduling are not exercised
The platform credential is a local classic PAT with no scopes; production storage and rotation remain later-phase work
Contribution visibility labels are owner-attested; expected public counts require owner confirmation
The public baseline request is read-only and asks for no repository objects
